title: CBD configuration
description: cbd.config.json at the repository root. Every key is optional; absent keys use the safe default described here.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete. Not read by CBD.

include.description: Repository-relative globs of files selection is responsible for. A changed file outside every pattern is ignored rather than escalated. Absent means every file in the repository.

exclude.description: Repository-relative globs removed from include, after include is applied.

alwaysAll.description: Globs whose change forces mode: all (lockfiles, manifests, tsconfig, migrations).

alwaysSelect.description: Tests every matching subset must include, for oracles that read sources as text and cannot appear in coverage. An entry the map cannot resolve forces mode: all and warns.

tests.description: Test locators: a repository-relative test file, or 'file > bare test title'.

when.description: Repository-relative globs of changes that trigger the entry. Absent means any in-scope change.

unknownPolicy.description: What to do with a changed file the map has never seen. 'all' is the safe default; 'ignore' selects nothing and can under-select.

betweenPolicy.description: What to do with a file reached only by @between. 'all' is the safe default.

testFiles.description: Globs of files that define tests. A test helper that defines none is answered from the map.

testFilePolicy.description: What a changed test file means. 'known' selects the tests the map already knows in that file and warns that an added test cannot be named; 'all' forces the whole suite. Default is 'known' because spec edits are common and 'all' would make most runs full.

maxAgeCommits.description: Warn when the map is this many commits behind HEAD. With strict: true, a stale map forces mode: all.

strict.description: Treat a stale or dirty map as mode: all rather than a warning.

stateDir.description: Where shards and maps live, relative to the repository root.

granularity.description: Only test-level windows are implemented. 'group' is a B2 lever and is rejected rather than ignored.
